# trade

Trades are intents: the script asks, the engine fills at a later block against the pool reserves, or rejects.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`trade.buy()`](#trade-buy) | Asks to buy alpha with TAO. |
| [`trade.sell()`](#trade-sell) | Asks to sell alpha from the position. |
| [`trade.closePosition()`](#trade-closeposition) | Sells the whole position. |
| [`trade.cancel()`](#trade-cancel) | Cancels an intent that has not filled yet. |
| [`trade.cancelAll()`](#trade-cancelall) | Cancels every intent that has not filled yet; returns how many. |
| [`trade.stop()`](#trade-stop) | Engine-managed: sell when price &lt;= level. |
| [`trade.takeProfit()`](#trade-takeprofit) | Engine-managed: sell when price &gt;= level. |
| [`trade.trailingStop()`](#trade-trailingstop) | Engine-managed: sell when price falls `pct` percent below the running high since creation. |
| [`trade.cancelConditional()`](#trade-cancelconditional) | Cancels an active stop, take-profit or trailing stop. |

### trade.buy() {#trade-buy}

```ts
trade.buy(options: BuyOptions): IntentId
```

Asks to buy alpha with TAO. Fills at a later block against the pool, or is rejected; see `event.onFill` and `event.onReject`. Returns null before the tester's trading start.

Types: [BuyOptions](#buyoptions), [IntentId](./types#intentid)

### trade.sell() {#trade-sell}

```ts
trade.sell(options: SellOptions): IntentId
```

Asks to sell alpha from the position. Long only: without a position the intent is rejected with "no-position". Returns null before the tester's trading start.

Types: [SellOptions](#selloptions), [IntentId](./types#intentid)

### trade.closePosition() {#trade-closeposition}

```ts
trade.closePosition(options?: { reason?: string }): IntentId | null
```

Sells the whole position. Returns null when there is no position.

Types: [IntentId](./types#intentid)

### trade.cancel() {#trade-cancel}

```ts
trade.cancel(id: IntentId): boolean
```

Cancels an intent that has not filled yet. Returns false when it already filled, expired or was rejected.

Types: [IntentId](./types#intentid)

### trade.cancelAll() {#trade-cancelall}

```ts
trade.cancelAll(): number
```

Cancels every intent that has not filled yet; returns how many.

### trade.stop() {#trade-stop}

```ts
trade.stop(options: ConditionalOptions & { price: Price }): string
```

Engine-managed: sell when price &lt;= level. Evaluated every block (precise/live) or at bar open/low/high/close (quick). Fills after the normal latency, never at the trigger price. Place it once the position exists (e.g. in `event.onPositionOpened`): an order checked while flat is cancelled.

Types: [ConditionalOptions](#conditionaloptions), [Price](./types#price)

### trade.takeProfit() {#trade-takeprofit}

```ts
trade.takeProfit(options: ConditionalOptions & { price: Price }): string
```

Engine-managed: sell when price &gt;= level.

Types: [ConditionalOptions](#conditionaloptions), [Price](./types#price)

### trade.trailingStop() {#trade-trailingstop}

```ts
trade.trailingStop(options: ConditionalOptions & { pct: number }): string
```

Engine-managed: sell when price falls `pct` percent below the running high since creation.

Types: [ConditionalOptions](#conditionaloptions)

### trade.cancelConditional() {#trade-cancelconditional}

```ts
trade.cancelConditional(id: string): boolean
```

Cancels an active stop, take-profit or trailing stop. Returns false when it already triggered or was cancelled.

## Types

### BuyOptions {#buyoptions}

Options of `trade.buy()`. Give the size as `tao` (TAO to spend, fee included) or as `alpha`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tao?` | `number` | TAO to spend, fee included |
| `alpha?` | `number` | alpha to buy, converted to TAO at the pool price when the intent fills |
| `maxPrice?` | [`Price`](./types#price) | reject (or partially fill) above this effective price |
| `ttlBlocks?` | `number` | blocks the intent may wait for a fill before it expires (default 3) |
| `partialOk?` | `boolean` | when the whole size would break `maxPrice` or exceed the cash, fill what fits instead of rejecting (default true) |
| `reason?` | `string` | a label shown in the journal and the tester's trade list |

### SellOptions {#selloptions}

Options of `trade.sell()`. Give the size as `alpha` or as `tao` (converted at the pool price).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha?` | `number` | alpha to sell; more than the position sells the whole position |
| `tao?` | `number` | TAO worth of alpha to sell, converted at the pool price when the intent fills |
| `minPrice?` | [`Price`](./types#price) | reject (or partially fill) below this price |
| `ttlBlocks?` | `number` | blocks the intent may wait for a fill before it expires (default 3) |
| `partialOk?` | `boolean` | when the whole size would break `minPrice`, fill what fits instead of rejecting (default true) |
| `reason?` | `string` | a label shown in the journal and the tester's trade list |

### ConditionalOptions {#conditionaloptions}

Options shared by the conditional orders.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha?` | `number \| "all"` | alpha to sell when triggered (default "all": the whole position) |
| `ttlBlocks?` | `number` | blocks the triggered sell may wait for a fill (default 3) |
| `reason?` | `string` | a label for the triggered sell (default: the order's kind) |

### Rejection {#rejection}

Why an intent was not filled, as passed to `event.onReject`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `intent` | [`Intent`](./account#intent) |  |
| `reason` | `string` | "price-limit" \| "no-position" \| "insufficient-cash" \| "empty" \| "no-price" \| "risk:&lt;rule&gt;" (e.g. "risk:maxOrderTao") |
